UI makes disclosed public use explicit for this exact input; root captures/hash retains the actual bytes outside argv/logs. A public transport, private profile or untrusted website does not classify arbitrary human content PUBLIC.

Any parent sensitivity PRIVATE/UNKNOWN, credentials/private attachment/history/memory/delegation content or uncaptured input invalidates the PUBLIC path. No source ancestry stripping, masking hash or consent-based downgrade. Existing source trust aggregation preserved: public web responses remain untrusted-source authority none, not authorization evidence.
public_source_observation.bounds: Reuse actual selected input/source capture schema and max_event_bytes; exact current immutable input SHA/size and retained source handles, no generic new source kind. Source kind remains native-input. Root input coordinator/selection store owns actual source observation independently of native pending request pair.

authority_rule: Dedicated existing root-selected source issuance path sets recipient_ceiling only to intersection of genuine current RootPublicInputPermission.public_recipient_ids and exact selected web scope recipients and every parent source ceiling, with allowed operations intersected to plugin.web.read. Source sensitivity must remain PUBLIC all ancestry; UNKNOWN/PRIVATE has empty public ceiling regardless permission. Existing source budget intersection stays zero additional. Authorization/revalidation always retains signed source receipts, checks every parent/current permission/scope/epoch/source lease and actual input identity. RootPrivateInputConsentRegistry remains private-only; no public provider chat/embedding/memory export permission is added.

Root-private handles only. Public input bytes retained only under existing bounded input lifetime; revoke/expiry cleanup does not erase required receipt digest audit.
